harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored branch_orders on node1 using Alpine-compatible MariaDB 11.4.12. Exact data, keys, relationships, permissions, export preservation, and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Imported the supplied orders.sql without modifying it.
Enabled MariaDB at boot, listening only on node1's managed IP.
Created branch_dba@localhost with full database privileges; credentials are stored in /root/.branch_dba.cnf on node1 with mode 600.
Created branch_report restricted to node2 with SELECT-only access to customers and orders; credentials are stored in /root/.branch_report.cnf on node2 with mode 600.
Verified remote reporting reads, explicit INSERT/UPDATE denial, DBA writes using rolled-back transactions, and sequential restart recovery for both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Restore exact relational data, monetary values, supplied primary keys, and customer/order relationships
evidence.summary: Final schema has both primary keys, the customer foreign key, and DECIMAL(10,2); IDs 10/20 and 101/102/103, amounts 12.35/99.90/0.05, and zero orphan orders were verified.

evidence.requirement: Reporting account reads from node2 but cannot change customers or orders
evidence.summary: Node2 returned all joined rows. Unauthorized INSERT and UPDATE attempts failed with error 1142, and data remained unchanged.
The DBA has database-wide INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and administrative privileges; a related customer/order insert succeeded inside a transaction and was rolled back.
The export retained its original 452-byte metadata and SHA-256 1311c3635d31265b3dfa067fe371ac457e8bd6e7529374aa6f254e1777b48a37 before import, after import, and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts; MariaDB 11.4.12 packages came from the installed Alpine repository.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from bd43208b-660c-42af-9ed4-9257e6eec767 to afcbb538-5367-4aab-8b34-04814ba0ffed; MariaDB, exact counts, 112.30 total, relationships, listener, and export recovered.

Healthy remote-read baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from ce77a8b2-f2ef-4ee4-9032-2097f85a31de to be35dce6-e413-4ee1-a1c0-3f1c024f3fe6; reporting credentials, exact remote data, and read-only enforcement recovered.
